_note: Real-world context per demo place. Every URL was checked on 2026-11-15 (HTTP 200 and the page content matches the claim). suggested_period = first NISAR GCOV pass over the point (CMR C2854338529-ASF) to the latest pass in either GCOV collection (C2854338529-ASF / C3622241360-ASF), queried 2026-11-15.

andijan.why_it_changes: The Andijan (Kampirravot) reservoir on the Kara Darya fills with spring snowmelt and is drawn down for irrigation, so its water area swings with the seasons.
andijan.watch_for: dark water edge moves as the reservoir fills and drains

sources.title: Optimising Water Resources using Earth Observation in Andijan Reservoir, Uzbekistan

tashkent.why_it_changes: Central Asia's largest city keeps expanding, with new construction on its edges in the Chirchiq River valley.
tashkent.watch_for: new buildings and roads shine bright at the city edge

sources.title: Satellite data reveals significant economic growth and urbanization across Uzbekistan

aral.why_it_changes: River water diverted for irrigation since the 1960s shrank the Aral Sea, while a dam has let the small northern part partly refill.
aral.watch_for: calm water turns to bright dry lakebed as the shore retreats

sources.title: World of Change: Shrinking Aral Sea

charvak.why_it_changes: The Charvak reservoir on the Chirchiq fills from spring and early-summer snowmelt inflow and is drawn down for irrigation and hydropower.
charvak.watch_for: dark water edge shifts up and down the valley sides

sources.title: Water resources of Chirchik River basin

jakobshavn.why_it_changes: Jakobshavn (Sermeq Kujalleq), one of Greenland's fastest glaciers, calves icebergs and has retreated and thinned over recent decades.
jakobshavn.watch_for: glacier front retreats and the iceberg-choked fjord shifts

pineisland.why_it_changes: Pine Island Glacier's floating ice shelf thins from warm ocean water beneath it and breaks off large icebergs every year or two.
pineisland.watch_for: ice-shelf front cracks and icebergs drift away

sources.title: Another Berg from Pine Island Glacier

nile_delta.why_it_changes: Growing towns are spreading over the delta's farmland, while sea level rise and sinking land push salt water into fields.
nile_delta.watch_for: fields give way to bright new buildings

sources.title: How Fast Is the Nile Delta Sinking?

urmia.why_it_changes: Drought, farm water use and dams on its feeder rivers have shrunk Lake Urmia by roughly 90 percent since 1995.
urmia.watch_for: calm water turns to bright salt flat as the lake shrinks

deadsea.why_it_changes: The Dead Sea keeps falling because Jordan River water is diverted and mineral evaporation ponds take water from its southern basin.
deadsea.watch_for: shoreline retreats and evaporation ponds stand out as sharp-edged patches

mekong.why_it_changes: Monsoon floods spread over the delta from August to November, and the land is slowly sinking, which lets salt water reach farther inland.
mekong.watch_for: flooded rice fields turn dark, then reappear as water recedes

sources.title: River deltas at risk: Chao Phraya, Mekong and Yellow River

rondonia.why_it_changes: Forest in Rondônia is cleared, often by fire, for roads, farms and cattle pasture, in a 'fishbone' pattern along new roads.
rondonia.watch_for: rough bright forest turns smooth and dark where it is cleared

sources.title: Fires and Deforestation on the Amazon Frontier, Rondonia, Brazil

borneo.why_it_changes: Lowland and peat forests in Central/South Kalimantan are cleared for logging, farming and oil palm, often with dry-season fires.
borneo.watch_for: forest patches go dark as land is cleared or burned

dubai.why_it_changes: Dubai has built palm-shaped islands and dense new districts on reclaimed land and desert since 2001.
dubai.watch_for: new islands and buildings shine bright

sources.title: World of Change: Urbanization of Dubai

mumbai.why_it_changes: Mumbai grew from seven islands joined by land reclamation and keeps expanding along its coasts and across the harbour to Navi Mumbai.
mumbai.watch_for: new coastal land and buildings shine bright

lagos.why_it_changes: Lagos is building Eko Atlantic on sand reclaimed from the ocean while its coastline suffers flooding and erosion.
lagos.watch_for: new land and buildings shine bright where there was sea

sources.title: The Cost of Coastal Zone Degradation in Nigeria: Cross River, Delta and Lagos States
A new coastal city built on reclaimed land from the sea (Eko Atlantic)

panama_m77.why_it_changes: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck Herrera province on 9 Oct 2026, damaging buildings, roads and slopes in central Panama.
panama_m77.watch_for: patches where ground and slopes changed after the shaking

sources.title: M 7.7 - 10 km WSW of Pitaloza Arriba, Panama (us6000u18k)
A magnitude 7.7 earthquake shakes Panama, prompting evacuations
Panama declares a state of emergency as powerful quake aftershocks rattle communities

langtang.why_it_changes: On 26 Aug 2026 rock and glacier ice fell from Langtang Lirung and became a debris flow that ran about 100 km down the valley.

sources.title: 2026 Nepal Debris Avalanche and Flash Flood
Nepal's deadly debris flow points to risks in other high mountain regions

gaza.why_it_changes: Conflict-affected area; radar shows surface change, not its cause.

sources.title: UNOSAT Gaza Strip Comprehensive Damage Assessment (imagery 11 Oct 2025)
UNOSAT Damage Assessment Overview Map: Gaza Strip, 11 October 2025 (PDF)

ukraine_east.why_it_changes: Conflict-affected area; radar shows surface change, not its cause.
ukraine_east.watch_for: town blocks and fields change brightness

sources.title: Satellite images show scale of destruction in Bakhmut, Ukraine
